title: Normalized integral Cartier pole-extension class
statement: Let $i:D\hookrightarrow Z$ be an effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Work on $Z_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and Ext defined in the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $F=i_*\mathbf Z_D$, $L=\mathcal O_Z(D)$, and let $P=\underline{\mathrm{Isom}}(\mathcal O,L)$ be its frame torsor. Use the supported integral unit $s:\mathbf Z_Z\to F$, its section $s(1)$, and the canonical divisor section on the complementary open as in [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Define $\mathrm{CartierPoleBoundarySpec}(i,\beta)$ for $\beta\in\mathrm{Ext}^1(F,\mathbf G_m)$ as follows. For every open $W=Z\setminus i(D)$ there exist a short exact extension $0\to\mathbf G_m\xrightarrow{a}E\xrightarrow{b}F\to0$, a morphism of underlying sheaves $f:P\to E$, and a frame $\tau$ of $L$ on $W$, such that $\tau$ is the canonical divisor section on $W$, $f(g\cdot p)=a(g)+f(p)$ on every etale object, $b(f(p))=s(1)$ restricted to that object, $f(\tau)=0$, and $\beta$ is the connecting extension class. Locally a frame is $t^{-1}$, so this fixes the quotient $t^{-1}\mapsto+1$ and the trivialization on the complement.
